responsibility: This implementation module provides floating-point terminal I/O on top of InOut and StringConvert. It reads tokens, trims leading whitespace, converts them to SHORTREAL, REAL, or LONGREAL values via StringToLongreal, formats output using LongrealToString with a configurable decimal-place count and left-padding, and also emits octal dumps of the in-memory byte representation of each floating type.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the RealInOut pair: it fulfills RealInOut.def by reading tokens from InOut, converting and formatting floating values, tracking Done, and emitting octal byte dumps.
